definition: animals from different litters, ideally a different shipment or breeding round
why: the original cohort's litter effects are baked into the original estimate; re-analysing the same animals is not replication

definition: a newly purchased lot, ideally from a different supplier, with identity and purity re-checked
why: a degraded or mis-identified lot reproduces itself perfectly. This is the cheapest failure mode to exclude and the one most often skipped

definition: arm labels masked from dissection through analysis lock; annotators guess at the end and the guess accuracy is reported
why: the same blinding standard as stage 72; a replication analysed unblinded is a confirmation exercise

definition: the stage-72 definitions file is reused byte-for-byte; no endpoint is added, dropped or redefined
why: the single most common way a replication becomes uninformative

definition: a different person performs dissection, culture, imaging and annotation
why: operator technique is a real variance component in explant culture and microdissection; if the effect only exists in one pair of hands it is an operator effect

definition: a second bone or a second strain - e.g. metatarsal and metacarpal, or a second inbred background
why: generalisation beyond one anatomical site; a metatarsal-only effect is a metatarsal result

definition: the height-to-width ratio moves in the SAME direction and the replicate effect size falls within 50-200% of the original point estimate
why: direction alone is too weak - a replication at a quarter of the effect size changes what the compound is. The band is wide because between-cohort variation is real, and it is stated in advance so it cannot be widened afterwards
the endpoint the project is about; geometry replicating without length is a different and lesser result

definition: EdU fraction >= 0.85x vehicle in the replicate cohort
why: a guard endpoint that passed once can fail in a new cohort, and that is a real finding rather than noise

definition: COL2A1, ACAN and extracellular COL10A1 each >= 0.85x vehicle, and the intracellular:extracellular collagen X ratio <= 1.3x
the primary engagement marker moves in the terminal zone by an amount within 50-200% of the original
why: engagement that does not replicate means the compound did not arrive or did not work, and the geometry result is then uninterpretable rather than negative

definition: curvature and appositional width within the vehicle band; blinded gross-shape score unchanged
why: a deformation that appears only in the second cohort is the more likely truth, not the outlier

definition: explant exclusion rate not more than double the original, and not differential between arms
why: a replication that excluded its way to agreement has not replicated
the compound reaches INDEPENDENTLY_REPLICATED_EX_VIVO_HIT - the first classification the brief allows to be called 'good enough to seriously consider for further research'

definition: direction agrees on both primary endpoints but the effect size falls below 50% of the original
why: not a pass. The original estimate is revised downward, the design is re-powered on the pooled estimate, and a third cohort decides. Reporting the original number afterwards is not permitted

definition: either primary endpoint reverses direction or fails to move
why: the compound returns to the classification it held before stage 72. The original result is reported as unreplicated, not withdrawn

definition: target engagement did not replicate, or the assay controls failed
why: the replication says nothing about the compound; it says the experiment did not run. Re-run before drawing any conclusion
